diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 48): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as ambiguous by the ADF/KPSS tests. The series crosses zero, so percentage errors are unstable and mean-based combinations are safer than ratio-based ones. Across validation windows the model ranking is unstable (Kendall tau 0.179), which favours a robust combination.
